_comment: CLAIM navier_stokes::5: with velocity Dirichlet data on every boundary facet the pressure is determined only up to a constant, because pressure enters the weak form only through its gradient. WHAT THIS RUNS: rather than depend on how a particular solver reacts to a singular saddle-point matrix, the fixture measures the null space directly - it assembles the P2/P1 lid-driven Stokes operator on an 8x8 unit square with velocity Dirichlet data on all exterior facets, builds the constant-pressure vector (1 on every pressure dof, 0 on velocity dofs) and applies the operator to it. OBSERVED, copied from the run: n_pressure_dofs=81; relative_norm_of_A_times_constant_pressure=2.939e-18; constant_pressure_is_in_the_kernel=True; VERDICT=enclosed_flow_leaves_the_pressure_constant_free. REPAIR 2026-08-06: the T2_MUTATE branch used to pin the pressure with dolfinx.fem.dirichletbc(pin, np.array([q_map[0]]), W.sub(1)), a single dof array, which a sub-space bc does not accept - it raised "TypeError: __init__(): incompatible function arguments", so the mutation went red by CRASHING rather than by removing the kernel, and any fixture copying the idiom inherited the bug. It now passes the dof PAIR [parent_dofs, collapsed_dofs] and genuinely pins one pressure dof. Re-verified by execution: with the pin in place the same relative product is 8.256e-03 (fifteen orders above round-off), nothing raises, constant_pressure_is_in_the_kernel=False and the forbidden VERDICT=pressure_is_determined appears - so the mutation now discriminates for the right reason. dolfinx 0.10.0 / basix 0.10.0 (conda env `fenics`, real scalars).
